job.title: Senior Estimating Lead
job.description:
Job Summary
The Role

The Senior Estimating Lead will take ownership of cost estimating and pricing across the company's project pipeline, working closely with the Commercial Director, Tendering, Procurement and Project Delivery teams. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can both build robust estimates themselves and bring structure, consistency and rigour to how the business prices its work. You will be the technical authority on cost build-up for tenders and change, acting as the bridge between early-stage bid pricing and the commercial/contract positions that follow through delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the end-to-end estimating process for solar EPC, BESS and ICP/BOP tenders, from first principles take-off through to final submission pricing.
Build and maintain detailed cost models covering civils, mechanical & electrical (M&E) installation, HV/LV connections, BESS containers and balance of plant, using rates derived from live projects, supplier quotations and benchmarked historical data.
Own and continue to develop Schedules of Rates (SOR) and tick-box estimating tools, calibrating them against completed and in-flight projects.
Work directly with Procurement to secure and interrogate supplier and subcontractor quotations, ensuring like-for-like comparisons and identifying scope gaps before submission.
Partner with the Tendering team to convert estimates into structured, client-ready pricing submissions (e.g. cost sheets, activity schedules, pricing schedules), and provide clear back-up and audit trail for every line.
Sense-check and quality-assure pricing before submission, including a second-pair-of-eyes review on high-value or complex lines.
Support cashflow and valuation modelling by ensuring estimates translate cleanly into milestone or monthly valuation structures for delivery teams.
Feed lessons learned from live projects (variations, EOTs, termination accounts, out-turn cost) back into the estimating baseline, so pricing gets sharper project on project.
Contribute to the ongoing Commercial Standardisation Programme.
Mentor and, over time, help build out a wider estimating function as the business pipeline grows.

What We're Looking For

The business is just as interested in strong estimators from a construction, M&E, civils or infrastructure background who can apply their skills to renewables, as we are in candidates with direct solar/BESS experience.

Essential Skills

Proven track record in estimating within construction, M&E, infrastructure, or renewable energy EPC, ideally at senior/lead level.
Strong grasp of first-principles cost build-up: labour, plant, materials, subcontract packages and preliminaries.
Confident working with civils and/or M&E scopes (cabling, HV/LV, switchgear, transformers, containerised plant), direct solar or BESS exposure is a strong plus but not a prerequisite.
Advanced Excel skills; comfortable building and maintaining structured cost models and rate libraries.
Strong commercial awareness; able to see how an estimate will play out through contract, valuation and risk allocation, not just at bid stage.
Excellent attention to detail, with the discipline to self-check high-value pricing before it goes out the door.
Clear communicator, comfortable presenting pricing and assumptions to Commercial, Procurement and senior stakeholders.

Desirable

Direct experience estimating solar PV EPC and/or BESS projects.
Familiarity with NEC, JCT or bespoke EPC contract forms and how estimating assumptions feed into contract risk.
Experience with estimating software or CVR/cost reporting tools.
Degree or professional qualification in Quantity Surveying, Construction Management, Engineering or a related discipline.

What this role offers    

A senior, high-visibility role at the heart of a growing renewable energy contractor.
Genuine influence over how the business prices and wins work, with direct line into the Commercial Director.
Exposure to a varied pipeline; solar EPC, BESS and ICP, spanning projects from a few MW to 80MWp and beyond.
A collaborative, close-knit Commercial team and the opportunity to help shape estimating practice as the function scales.
Competitive salary and benefits, dependent on experience.

Company Summary

Our Client is a renewable energy company committed to providing sustainable and ethical power solutions. With a focus on reducing carbon emissions and promoting environmental responsibility, Our Client offers a range of clean energy options for businesses and individuals looking to make a positive impact on the planet. Through innovative technology and a dedication to ethical business practices, Our Client is leading the way towards a greener, more sustainable future. Join us in our mission to power a cleaner world for generations to come.

job.title: Quantity Surveyor
job.description:
Job Summary
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Quantity Surveyor to join our growing team. You will play a key role in managing project costs, ensuring value for money, and supporting the successful delivery of construction projects from inception through to completion.

Key Responsibilities

Prepare cost estimates, budgets, and feasibility studies
Manage all aspects of project cost control and financial reporting
Evaluate tender submissions and assist in contractor selection
Prepare and administer contracts (e.g., NEC, JCT)
Monitor project progress, variations, and cost changes
Produce interim valuations, cost reports, and final accounts
Liaise with clients, contractors, and stakeholders
Identify and manage project risks and opportunities
Ensure compliance with industry regulations and standards

Requirements

Degree in Quantity Surveying, Construction Management, or related field
Previous experience in a Quantity Surveyor role (X+ years depending on level)
Strong knowledge of construction contracts (NEC/JCT)
Excellent commercial awareness and negotiation skills
Proficient in Microsoft Excel and cost management tools
Strong communication and organisational skills
Full UK driving licence (if site visits required)

Desirable

MRICS or working towards professional accreditation

Experience across [sector – e.g., residential, commercial, infrastructure]

Company Summary

Our Client is a leading project services company that specializes in providing comprehensive solutions for a wide range of projects. With a team of experienced professionals, Our Client offers services such as project management, procurement, and construction management to ensure successful project delivery. Their commitment to quality, efficiency, and client satisfaction sets them apart in the industry. Whether it's a small renovation or a large-scale development, Our Client has the expertise and resources to handle any project with precision and expertise. Choose Our Client for your next project and experience the difference in quality and service.

job.title: Senior Quantity Surveyor
job.description:
An exciting opportunity to join a great team as Senior Quantity Surveyor. Ideal for an experienced SQS or someone who feels prepared and ready to step up into a more senior role.

The role is accountable for protecting and maximising project profitability through effective contract administration, cost control, change management, cash collection, and commercial risk management. The Senior QS provides leadership and development to the commercial team, ensuring consistent processes, high-quality reporting, and strong commercial governance across all projects.

Principle Accountabilities: 

  • Representing the company in a professional and competent manner at all times and developing strong working relationships with colleagues and clients.
  • To ensure effective written and verbal communication of all contractual, commercial, financial, corporate and operational issues within the area.
  • Lead the commercial management of all Fire & Security installation projects.
  • Ensure all projects are commercially set up correctly following contract award.
  • Review contract terms and identify commercial risks and obligations.
  • Maintain robust commercial records throughout project delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and agreement of Final Accounts.
  • Ensure all variations are identified, priced, submitted and agreed promptly.
  • Work with operational teams to maximise recovery of additional works.
  • Support debt recovery alongside the Finance department.
  • Maintain positive project cashflow.
  • Reduce Work in Progress (WIP) exposure.
  • Produce monthly commercial reports for Directors.
  • Report project profitability, risks and opportunities.
  • Provide forecasting information for business cashflow.
  • Ensure commercial procedures are consistently followed.
  • Develop and improve commercial systems and processes.
  • Plan, prioritise and allocate workload across the commercial team.
  • Conduct regular one-to-one meetings and performance reviews.
  • Coach, mentor and develop team members to improve commercial competence. 
  • Identify training and development needs and support progression through structured development plans.
  • Ensure consistency in commercial processes, reporting standards and contract administration across the team.




Company Summary

Our Client is a leading engineering services company that specializes in providing innovative solutions for retail and specialist projects. With a proven track record of delivering high-quality services, Our Client is dedicated to ensuring the success of every project they undertake. From design and construction to maintenance and repair, Our Client offers a comprehensive range of services to meet the needs of their clients. With a team of experienced professionals and a commitment to excellence, Our Client is the trusted choice by many blue chip organisations for building engineering services.

- Discretionary bonus
- Car allowance
